description: 한국도로공사 전북권출발 지역간 년누계교통량 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 한국도로공사가 전북권 고속도로 출발 영업소를 기준으로 집계한 연간 누계 교통량 정보를 제공한다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 권역, 전북, 교통량, 통계자료, 도착영업소. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
